series.first_panic: model=3 off=1389361: index out of bounds: the len is 13220 but the index is 13220

findings.statement: a damaged file produces an error, never a panic
findings.detail: 65/5000 trials (1.3%) took the process down instead of returning Err. First: model=3 off=1389361: index out of bounds: the len is 13220 but the index is 13220

findings.statement: damage to stored data is detected rather than served
findings.detail: 3689/5000 trials (73.8%) read the damaged file through to the end without complaint. Nothing outside the 120-byte superblock carries a checksum, so there is nothing for the engine to notice

notes: The bar is not recovery, or even detection: it is that a library embedded in another process must return an error rather than abort it
